name: REVIVER v25
notes: PC stats labels follow what each number measures: CPU, GPU, RAM or DISK (pick in the PC stats tab), drawn in the keyboard's own label style. Everything from v24: PC stats as a built-in screen with temperature or usage per number, your own screen list, a screen for every screen package, changeable boot logo, the image screen, live drawing, tear-free scrolling, screen-off support.
